jobs.name: hermes-stea-crmmiam02-backup
jobs.prompt:
Run the following bash command exactly:

```bash
cd ~/.hermes
git pull || { echo "ERROR: git pull failed"; exit 1; }
git push || true
git add -A
if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
  git commit -m "hermes STEA CRMMIAM02 VIRTUAL_MACHINE_UID=906 backup: $(date +'%Y-%m-%d %H-%M-%S')"
else
  git commit --allow-empty -m "hermes STEA CRMMIAM02 VIRTUAL_MACHINE_UID=906 backup: $(date +'%Y-%m-%d %H-%M-%S')"
fi
git pull --rebase || { echo "ERROR: git pull --rebase failed"; exit 1; }
git push || echo "WARN: git push failed (may be up to date)"
```

If any step fails, report the error. Do not prompt or ask for confirmation.
